entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bi Bi Monajemeh Nishaburi also known as Monajemeh Nishaburi or Bichai Munachchima was a Persian-Tajik poet, mathematician and astronomer. She is chiefly known for her astronomical works. She was born in Nishapur, now in modern Iran.
